text: えを　かいてるのよ　しかいに　はいって　こないで！

structure.jp: えを　かいてるのよ
structure.en: I'm painting a picture, you know

structure.jp: しかいに　はいって　こないで！
structure.en: don't come into my field of view!

patterns.name: 〜ないで
patterns.explanation: ないで at the end of a sentence is a casual 'please don't'. こないで = 'don't come'.

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.span: はいって　こないで
patterns.explanation: くる after a て-form verb shows the movement is toward the speaker. はいって こないで = 'don't come in here'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: てる is the shortened spoken form of ている, which says the thing is going on right now. かいてる = 'I'm painting'.
